craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as śāmbhavī mudrā with adbhuta; sthāyibhāva bhakti in the mode of pratyabhijñā (recognition), vyabhicāri wonder (C1 rasa block). Verse color: paradox held steady resolving into grace-given recognition. Firing structures: the oxymoron paśyan/apaśyan is given by the source and is the verse's hinge -> isolate 'seeing, yet unseeing' on its own line (the eye stops where the gaze stops); the long opening bahuvrīhi (antarlakṣyavilīnacittapavanaḥ) is one inward breath -> first line unbroken; vocative turn (guro) -> colon address; terminal doctrine word (śāmbhavam) -> end-weight the state name. Dashes as chant breaths. Minimal pass: reline L3 into breath units + paradox-pivot device; no diction changes beyond L3's own words.

lines: When the yogin rests — mind and breath dissolved in the inward aim —
seeing, yet unseeing, outward, with motionless gaze —
this indeed becomes śāmbhavī mudrā, by your grace, O guru:
reality free of void and non-void — the śāmbhava state.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antarlakṣyavilīnacittapavano yogī yadā vartate dṛṣṭyā niścalatārayā bahirasau paśyannapaśyannapi | mudreyaṃ khalu śāmbhavī bhavati sā yuṣmatprasādādguro śūnyāśūnyavivarjitaṃ bhavati yat tattvaṃ padaṃ śāmbhavam

reads_against.argmap: premises (dissolution + seeing-yet-not-seeing; becomes mudrā by grace alone; reality free of extremes) + inference (dissolution not effort; grace alone, beyond extremes)
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta; bhakti as pratyabhijñā; wonder integrated into the śāmbhava state
reads_against.l2: When the yogin abides with mind-wind dissolved in the inward aim — he, seeing yet not seeing outside with unmoving-pupil gaze — this indeed becomes the śāmbhavī mudrā, by your grace, O guru: devoid of void and non-void becomes that reality, the śāmbhava state.
